signature: SUBROUTINE ZLAQR5( WANTT, WANTZ, KACC22, N, KTOP, KBOT, NSHFTS, S,

params.name: wantt
params.reference: `WANTT` = .true. if the triangular Schur factor is being computed. `WANTT` is set to .false. otherwise.

params.name: wantz
params.reference: `WANTZ` = .true. if the unitary Schur factor is being computed. `WANTZ` is set to .false. otherwise.

params.name: kacc22
params.reference:
Specifies the computation mode of far-from-diagonal orthogonal updates.

-   `= 0`: ZLAQR5 does not accumulate reflections and does not use matrix-matrix multiply to update far-from-diagonal matrix entries.
-   `= 1`: ZLAQR5 accumulates reflections and uses matrix-matrix multiply to update the far-from-diagonal matrix entries.
-   `= 2`: Same as `KACC22 = 1`. This option used to enable exploiting the 2-by-2 structure during matrix multiplications, but this is no longer supported.

params.name: N
params.reference: N is the order of the Hessenberg matrix H upon which this subroutine operates.

params.name: kbot
params.reference:
These are the first and last rows and columns of an isolated diagonal block upon which the QR sweep is to be applied. It is assumed without a check that

either `KTOP = 1` or $H(\mathrm{KTOP},\mathrm{KTOP}-1) = 0$

and

either `KBOT = N` or $H(\mathrm{KBOT}+1,\mathrm{KBOT}) = 0$.

params.name: nshfts
params.reference: `NSHFTS` gives the number of simultaneous shifts. `NSHFTS` must be positive and even.

params.name: s
params.reference: S contains the shifts of origin that define the multi- shift QR sweep. On output S may be reordered.

params.name: H
params.reference: On input H contains a Hessenberg matrix. On output a multi-shift QR sweep with shifts $\mathrm{SR}(J)+i \, \mathrm{SI}(J)$ is applied to the isolated diagonal block in rows and columns `KTOP` through `KBOT`.

params.name: ldh
params.reference: `LDH` is the leading dimension of H just as declared in the calling procedure. $\mathrm{LDH} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: ihiz
params.reference: Specify the rows of Z to which transformations must be applied if `WANTZ` is .TRUE.. $1 \le \mathrm{ILOZ} \le \mathrm{IHIZ} \le N$

params.name: Z
params.reference: If `WANTZ` = .TRUE., then the QR Sweep unitary similarity transformation is accumulated into `Z(ILOZ:IHIZ,ILOZ:IHIZ)` from the right. If `WANTZ` = .FALSE., then Z is unreferenced.

params.name: ldz
params.reference: LDA is the leading dimension of Z just as declared in the calling procedure. $\mathrm{LDZ} \ge N$.

params.name: ldv
params.reference: `LDV` is the leading dimension of V as declared in the calling procedure. $\mathrm{LDV} \ge 3$.

params.name: ldu
params.reference: `LDU` is the leading dimension of U just as declared in the in the calling subroutine. $\mathrm{LDU} \ge 2 \, \mathrm{NSHFTS}$.

params.name: nv
params.reference: `NV` is the number of rows in `WV` agailable for workspace. $\mathrm{NV} \ge 1$.

params.name: ldwv
params.reference: `LDWV` is the leading dimension of `WV` as declared in the in the calling subroutine. $\mathrm{LDWV} \ge \mathrm{NV}$.

params.name: nh
params.reference: `NH` is the number of columns in array `WH` available for workspace. $\mathrm{NH} \ge 1$.

params.name: ldwh
params.reference: Leading dimension of `WH` just as declared in the calling procedure. $\mathrm{LDWH} \ge 2 \, \mathrm{NSHFTS}$.
